Though Phantylia, the master primus of all evil, was eliminated, the Ambrosial Arbor it poisoned was on the verge of losing control. This towering plant sprouted rapidly, and the Abominations of Abundance hiding in its branches and veins poured into the human realm as they gained bodies of corporeal flesh and blood.

{NICKNAME} knew that, should the Ambrosial Arbor be allowed to grow to its full, the Xianzhou Luofu shall be reduced to a ship of the dead. Faced with veritable tsunamis of Abominations of Abundance, {NICKNAME} signaled the band of heroes to retreat while providing cover for them.

At that precipitous moment, {F#she}{M#he} yelled: "{TEXTJOIN#62}" Like a lightning bolt that slammed into the ground, the light that exploded out of {TEXTJOIN#61} engulfed all, stabbing toward and tearing apart the Ambrosial Arbor, destroying the very sky itself. For a moment, the ground toppled, and the sky trembled in the Xianzhou's countless delves, as if the Reignbow had returned to shoot down stars, as if the death of the divine wood sent up a cataclysmic dust storm.

After the clouds dissipated a few days later and the Xianzhou returned to peace, the Cloud Knights guarding the Arbor sought unceasingly for {NICKNAME} and yet could not find a single trace of them, just like the ephemeral theophany of the Reignbow. When General Jing Yuan heard the news, he could not help but lament and shed tears worthy for a hero. However, though the general is wise, he did not divine that legendary characters such as {NICKNAME} will never die in the company of demons and crowns. Blessed by the Cloudstrider, {NICKNAME} had already left the devastation and quietly started on a new hero's journey. The Ruin Legion still ravages the starry seas, and the worlds waiting for salvation are endless. The legend of the heroes of the Trailblaze continues on!

As it is said:
Serene was the Xianzhou, free from harm. Quiet was the palace, rich in charm.
Until the demons breached the gate, leaving the palace bloodied by fate.
Then comes a {M#hero}{F#heroine}, tall and strong. Flesh and iron, seven feet long.
Evil minions fall to {M#his}{F#her} might. Under {M#his}{F#her} staff, they bleed in flight.
Mounting the clouds, {M#he}{F#she} pursues all foes. Riding the dragon, {M#he}{F#she} purges all woes.
Towards the sky, {M#he}{F#she} splits through. Onto the arbor, {M#he}{F#she} strikes true.
